description: Covers operating systems, security, software troubleshooting, and operational procedures. Must be taken alongside Core 1 (220-1201) to earn the CompTIA A+ certification.

title: CompTIA Project+
description: Validates skills to manage IT projects end-to-end including team leadership, scheduling, documentation, and governance.

title: CompTIA CySA+
description: Intermediate cybersecurity certification validating ability to detect, analyze, and stop threats through vulnerability management and incident response.

title: CompTIA Data+
description: Entry-level data analytics certification proving ability to analyze, visualize, and communicate data insights for business decision-making.

title: CompTIA Cloud+
description: Proves ability to design, secure, and optimize multi-cloud environments covering architecture, deployment, DevOps, and troubleshooting.

title: Claude Certified Architect – Foundations
description: Foundational certification covering Claude AI architecture, prompt engineering, API integration, implementation patterns, and responsible AI practices.

title: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
description: Foundational knowledge and skills in Kubernetes and the wider cloud native ecosystem. Demonstrates conceptual knowledge of the entire cloud native ecosystem, particularly focusing on Kubernetes.

title: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Security Associate (KCSA)
description: Pre-professional certification for candidates interested in security technologies in the cloud native ecosystem. Demonstrates understanding of baseline security configuration of Kubernetes clusters to meet compliance objectives.

title: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
description: Design, build, configure, and expose cloud native applications for Kubernetes. Can define application resources and use core primitives to build, monitor, and troubleshoot scalable applications and tools in Kubernetes.

title: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
description: Skills, knowledge, and competency to perform the responsibilities of Kubernetes administrators. Demonstrates the ability to do basic installation as well as configuring and managing production-grade Kubernetes clusters.

title: Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS)
description: Broad range of security best practices for container-based applications and Kubernetes platforms. Covers skills for securing container-based applications and Kubernetes platforms during build, deployment and runtime. Requires current CKA certification.

title: Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
description: Entry-level certification covering Azure cloud services, cloud computing concepts, core Azure services, security, privacy, compliance, and trust.

title: Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
description: Validates ability to manage Azure subscriptions, identities, governance, storage, compute resources, virtual networks, and monitor Azure resources.

title: Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204)

title: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

title: Microsoft Certified: Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)

title: Microsoft Certified: Data Engineer Associate (AZ-DE)

title: Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)

title: Microsoft Certified: AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)

title: Microsoft Certified: Microsoft 365 Security Administrator Expert (MD-100)
